--!nonstrict
local Registry={}
local types={Player=true,Integer=true,Slap=true}
function Registry.Build(manifest,loadApproved)
 local out={ById={},Order={}}
 for _,name in ipairs(manifest)do
  assert(type(name)=='string'and name:match('^%w+$'),'Invalid admin manifest entry')
  local command=loadApproved(name)
  assert(type(command)=='table'and command.Id==name and not out.ById[name],'Invalid/duplicate admin command')
  assert(type(command.DisplayName)=='string'and type(command.Description)=='string'and type(command.Execute)=='function'and type(command.Fields)=='table','Invalid admin contract')
  local names={};local target=false
  for _,field in ipairs(command.Fields)do
   assert(type(field.Name)=='string'and not names[field.Name]and types[field.Type]and type(field.Label)=='string','Invalid/duplicate admin field')
   if field.Type=='Integer'then assert(type(field.Min)=='number'and type(field.Max)=='number'and field.Min>=0 and field.Max>=field.Min and field.Max<9007199254740992,'Invalid integer bounds')end
   if field.Name=='TargetUserId'and field.Type=='Player'then target=true end
   names[field.Name]=true
  end
  assert(target,'Admin command requires an explicit target player')
  out.ById[name]=command;table.insert(out.Order,name)
 end
 return out
end
function Registry.Public(registry)
 local result={}
 for _,id in ipairs(registry.Order)do local c=registry.ById[id];local fields={}
  for _,f in ipairs(c.Fields)do table.insert(fields,{Name=f.Name,Label=f.Label,Type=f.Type,Min=f.Min,Max=f.Max})end
  table.insert(result,{Id=c.Id,DisplayName=c.DisplayName,Description=c.Description,Fields=fields})
 end
 return result
end
function Registry.Validate(command,args,deps)
 if type(args)~='table'then return false,'InvalidArguments'end
 local expected={};local clean={}
 for _,field in ipairs(command.Fields)do
  expected[field.Name]=true;local value=args[field.Name]
  if field.Type=='Player'then
   if type(value)~='number'or value~=value or value%1~=0 or value==0 or math.abs(value)>=9007199254740992 or (not deps.IsStudio and value<0)then return false,'InvalidTarget'end
   if not deps.Player(value)then return false,'PlayerNotConnected'end
  elseif field.Type=='Integer'then
   if type(value)~='number'or value~=value or value%1~=0 or value<field.Min or value>field.Max then return false,'InvalidAmount'end
  elseif field.Type=='Slap'then
   if type(value)~='string'or #value>96 or not deps.Slap(value)then return false,'InvalidSlap'end
  end
  clean[field.Name]=value
 end
 for name in pairs(args)do if not expected[name]then return false,'UnexpectedArgument'end end
 return true,clean
end
return Registry

local Access=require(script.Parent.Parent.Access)
return {
 Id='GrantCoins',DisplayName='Dar Coins',Description='Acredita Coins al jugador conectado. No concede premios de combate.',
 Fields={{Name='TargetUserId',Label='Jugador',Type='Player'},{Name='Amount',Label='Cantidad de Coins',Type='Integer',Min=1,Max=Access.MaxCoinsPerGrant}},
 Execute=function(context,args)
  local ps=context.PlayerService;local target=context.Target
  if not ps:IsShopDataReady(target)then return {Ok=false,Reason='DataNotLoaded'}end
  local current=ps:GetCoins(target)
  if current>9007199254740991-args.Amount then return {Ok=false,Reason='BalanceOverflow'}end
  local balance,credited=ps:AddCoins(target,args.Amount,'AdminGrant',context.OperationId)
  return {Ok=credited==args.Amount,Reason=credited==args.Amount and 'CoinsGranted'or 'NotCredited',Balance=balance,Granted=credited}
 end,
}

return {
 Id='GrantSlap',DisplayName='Dar Slap',Description='Otorga propiedad de una variación del catálogo. No equipa ni fabrica unidades comerciables.',
 Fields={{Name='TargetUserId',Label='Jugador',Type='Player'},{Name='RewardId',Label='Slap / variación',Type='Slap'}},
 Execute=function(context,args)
  local ps=context.PlayerService;local target=context.Target
  if not ps:IsShopDataReady(target)then return {Ok=false,Reason='DataNotLoaded'}end
  if ps:HasItem(target,'Slaps',args.RewardId)then return {Ok=true,Reason='AlreadyOwned',RewardId=args.RewardId}end
  local ok,granted,why=pcall(ps.AddItem,ps,target,'Slaps',args.RewardId)
  -- UI notification failure cannot turn an already granted entitlement into an error/retry.
  if ps:HasItem(target,'Slaps',args.RewardId)then return {Ok=true,Reason='SlapGranted',RewardId=args.RewardId}end
  return {Ok=false,Reason=ok and why or 'GrantFailed'}
 end,
}

--!nonstrict
local Players=game:GetService('Players')
local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local Run=game:GetService('RunService')
local Http=game:GetService('HttpService')
local Folder=script.Parent.Parent.Admin
local Access=require(Folder.Access)
local Registry=require(Folder.CommandRegistry)
local Catalog=require(RS.Shared.SlapCrates.Catalog)
local Service={Name='AdminService'}
function Service:IsAdmin(player)
 if not player or player.Parent~=Players or Players:GetPlayerByUserId(player.UserId)~=player then return false end
 return Access.UserIds[player.UserId]==true or Run:IsStudio()and Access.StudioUserIds[player.UserId]==true
end
function Service:IsGrantableSlap(id)
 local reward=Catalog.Rewards[id];if not reward or reward.LimitedStock or reward.PremiumOnly then return false end
 local variation=Catalog.Variations.ById[reward.VariationId];local slap=Catalog.Slaps.ById[reward.SlapId]
 return variation and not variation.LimitedStock and not variation.PremiumOnly and slap and not slap.PremiumOnly
  and self.Slaps:GetSlapTemplate(slap.Model)~=nil
end
function Service:Info()
 local players={};for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do table.insert(players,{UserId=p.UserId,Username=p.Name,DisplayName=p.DisplayName})end
 table.sort(players,function(a,b)return a.UserId<b.UserId end)
 local slaps={};for id,r in pairs(Catalog.Rewards)do if self:IsGrantableSlap(id)then table.insert(slaps,{Id=id,Label=r.DisplayName})end end
 table.sort(slaps,function(a,b)return a.Id<b.Id end)
 return {Ok=true,Commands=Registry.Public(self.Registry),Players=players,Slaps=slaps}
end
function Service:Audit(actor,command,target,result,operation)
 local row={ActorUserId=actor.UserId,Command=command,TargetUserId=target,OperationId=operation,Ok=result.Ok==true,Reason=result.Reason,Timestamp=os.time()}
 table.insert(self.AuditRows,row);if #self.AuditRows>Access.MaxAuditEntries then table.remove(self.AuditRows,1)end
 print('[AdminAudit] '..Http:JSONEncode(row))
end
function Service:Request(actor,action,requestId,commandId,args)
 -- This check is repeated on EVERY call; button visibility is never authorization.
 if not self:IsAdmin(actor)then return {Ok=false,Reason='Forbidden'}end
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 if now-(self.LastRequest[actor]or -math.huge)<Access.RequestInterval then return {Ok=false,Reason='RateLimited'}end
 self.LastRequest[actor]=now
 if action=='Info'then return self:Info()end
 if action~='Execute'or type(requestId)~='string'or #requestId<8 or #requestId>96 or requestId:find('[^%w_%-]')or type(commandId)~='string'then return {Ok=false,Reason='InvalidRequest'}end
 local command=self.Registry.ById[commandId];if not command then return {Ok=false,Reason='UnknownCommand'}end
 local ok,clean=Registry.Validate(command,args,{IsStudio=Run:IsStudio(),Player=function(id)return Players:GetPlayerByUserId(id)end,Slap=function(id)return self:IsGrantableSlap(id)end})
 if not ok then return {Ok=false,Reason=clean}end
 local cache=self.Operations[actor];if not cache then cache={Count=0,Rows={}};self.Operations[actor]=cache end
 local signature=commandId;for _,field in ipairs(command.Fields)do signature..='|'..field.Name..'='..tostring(clean[field.Name])end
 local previous=cache.Rows[requestId]
 if previous then
  if previous.Signature~=signature then return {Ok=false,Reason='RequestIdConflict'}end
  return previous.Result or {Ok=false,Reason='OperationPending'}
 end
 if cache.Count>=Access.MaxRequestsPerAdminSession then return {Ok=false,Reason='SessionRequestLimit'}end
 local target=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(clean.TargetUserId)
 if not target or not self.Profiles:IsShopDataReady(target)then return {Ok=false,Reason='DataNotLoaded'}end
 local operation='Admin:'..Http:GenerateGUID(false)
 local record={Signature=signature};cache.Rows[requestId]=record;cache.Count+=1
 local success,result=pcall(command.Execute,{Actor=actor,Target=target,OperationId=operation,PlayerService=self.Profiles},clean)
 if not success or type(result)~='table'then result={Ok=false,Reason='ExecutionFailedNoAutoRetry'}end
 result.OperationId=operation;record.Result=result
 self:Audit(actor,commandId,target.UserId,result,operation)
 return result
end
function Service:Init(context)
 self.Context=context;self.Profiles=context:GetService('PlayerService');self.Slaps=context:GetService('SlapService')
 assert(self.Profiles and self.Slaps,'Admin dependencies missing')
 self.LastRequest={};self.Operations={};self.AuditRows={};self.Connections={}
 self.Registry=Registry.Build(require(Folder.CommandManifest),function(name)
  local found;for _,obj in ipairs(Folder.Commands:GetChildren())do if obj.Name==name then assert(not found,'Duplicate admin module');found=obj end end
  assert(found and found:IsA('ModuleScript'),'Unauthorized/missing admin module');return require(found)
 end)
 local remotes=RS:WaitForChild('Remotes');local folder=remotes:FindFirstChild('Admin')
 if not folder then folder=Instance.new('Folder');folder.Name='Admin';folder.Parent=remotes end
 local request=folder:FindFirstChild('Request');if not request then request=Instance.new('RemoteFunction');request.Name='Request';request.Parent=folder end
 assert(request:IsA('RemoteFunction'),'Admin remote class mismatch');self.Remote=request
end
function Service:Start()
 self.Remote.OnServerInvoke=function(actor,...)return self:Request(actor,...)end
 local function bind(p)p:SetAttribute('AdminPanelAllowed',self:IsAdmin(p))end
 for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do bind(p)end
 table.insert(self.Connections,Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bind))
 table.insert(self.Connections,Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)self.LastRequest[p]=nil;self.Operations[p]=nil end))
end
return Service

local Players=game:GetService('Players')
local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local Run=game:GetService('RunService')
local Http=game:GetService('HttpService')
local Config=require(RS.Shared.Config)
local Settings=require(RS.Shared.TrainingConfig)
local State=require(script.Parent.Gameplay.TrainingState)
local Service={Name='TrainingService'}
function Service:IsInside(player)
 local c=player.Character;local root=c and c:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
 if player.Parent~=Players or not root or not h or h.Health<=0 or not self.Bounds or not self.Bounds:IsDescendantOf(workspace)then return false end
 if self.Rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(player)or player:GetAttribute('ResultsSessionId')~=nil then return false end
 local p=self.Bounds.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position);local half=self.Bounds.Size/2
 return math.abs(p.X)<=half.X and math.abs(p.Y)<=half.Y and math.abs(p.Z)<=half.Z
end
function Service:IsAuthorizedTool(player,tool)
 local r=self.Sessions and self.Sessions[player]
 return r~=nil and r.Tool==tool and r.Character==player.Character and tool.Parent==player.Character and self:IsInside(player)
end
function Service:Stop(player)
 local r=self.Sessions[player];if not r then return end
 self.Sessions[player]=nil
 if r.Connection then r.Connection:Disconnect()end
 if r.Tool then r.Tool:Destroy()end
 if player.Parent==Players and player:GetAttribute('TrainingSessionId')==r.Id then player:SetAttribute('TrainingSessionId',nil)end
end
function Service:Join(player)
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 if now-(self.LastEntry[player]or -math.huge)<.5 then return end
 self.LastEntry[player]=now
 if self.Sessions[player]then self:Stop(player);return end
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
 if not self:IsInside(player)or not root or (root.Position-self.Entry.Position).Magnitude>Settings.EntryDistance then return end
 local crates=self.Context:GetService('CrateService');local reward=crates and crates:ResolveEquipped(player)
 local name=reward and crates:GetSlapModel(reward)or 'Classic';local template=self.Slaps:GetSlapTemplate(name)
 if not template then return end
 local tool=template:Clone();tool.Name='Slap de práctica';tool.CanBeDropped=false
 for _,o in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants())do if o:IsA('LuaSourceContainer')then o:Destroy()end end
 tool:SetAttribute('IsSlapWeapon',false);tool:SetAttribute('IsTrainingSlap',true)
 if reward then crates:ApplyVariation(tool,reward)end
 local record={Id=Http:GenerateGUID(false),Character=player.Character,Tool=tool,ReadyAt=0,LastSequence=0}
 self.Sessions[player]=record
 record.Connection=player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()if self.Sessions[player]==record then self:Stop(player)end end)
 player:SetAttribute('TrainingSessionId',record.Id)
 local backpack=player:FindFirstChildOfClass('Backpack');local hum=player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
 tool.Parent=backpack or player.Character;if backpack then hum:EquipTool(tool)end
end
function Service:Feedback(player,record,sequence,hit,reason)
 if player.Parent==Players then self.Updated:FireClient(player,{SessionId=record.Id,Sequence=sequence,Hit=hit,Reason=reason,ReadyAt=record.ReadyAt or 0})end
end
function Service:RecoverDummy()
 if self.Recovery then pcall(task.cancel,self.Recovery);self.Recovery=nil end
 local dummy=self.Dummy
 if not dummy or not dummy.Parent then return end
 local root=dummy:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
 if not root then return end
 root.Anchored=true;self.Ragdoll:ResetRagdollImmediate(dummy,true)
 dummy:PivotTo(self.Home.CFrame)
 for _,p in ipairs(dummy:GetDescendants())do if p:IsA('BasePart')then p.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;p.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero end end
 local h=dummy:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid');if h then h.WalkSpeed=0;h.JumpPower=0;h.Jump=false end
 root.Anchored=true;self.DummyDown=false;dummy:SetAttribute('TrainingReadyAt',nil)
end
function Service:HitDummy(attackerRoot,power)
 local dummy=self.Dummy;local root=dummy and dummy:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');local h=dummy and dummy:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
 if self.DummyDown or not root or not h or h.Health<=0 or self.Ragdoll:IsRagdolled(dummy)then return false,'DummyProtected'end
 local reachable=self.Slaps:CheckTargetGeometry(attackerRoot,root)
 if not reachable then return false,'Miss'end
 self.DummyDown=true;root.Anchored=false
 for _,p in ipairs(dummy:GetDescendants())do if p:IsA('BasePart')then pcall(function()p:SetNetworkOwner(nil)end)end end
 local velocity=self.Slaps:ComputeSlapLaunchVelocity(attackerRoot,root,power)
 -- Only this service owns recovery/return for its one explicit NPC. Never tag a Player.
 local ok=self.Ragdoll:ApplyRagdoll(dummy,0,velocity)
 if not ok then self:RecoverDummy();return false,'RagdollUnavailable'end
 local duration=Config.Combat.DefaultSlapKnockdownDuration
 dummy:SetAttribute('TrainingReadyAt',workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+duration)
 self.Recovery=task.delay(duration,function()self.Recovery=nil;if self.Dummy==dummy then self:RecoverDummy()end end)
 return true
end
function Service:Activate(player,tool,sessionId,sequence)
 local record=self.Sessions[player]
 if not record or record.Id~=sessionId or not self:IsAuthorizedTool(player,tool)then return end
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 if now-(record.LastRequest or -math.huge)<Settings.RequestInterval then return end
 record.LastRequest=now
 local started,why=State.Begin(record,sequence,now)
 if not started then if why~='InvalidSequence'then self:Feedback(player,record,sequence,false,why)end;return end
 local config=tool:FindFirstChild('Configuration');local p=config and config:FindFirstChild('Power');local c=config and config:FindFirstChild('SlapCooldown')
 if not p or not c or not p:IsA('NumberValue')or not c:IsA('NumberValue')or p.Value~=p.Value or p.Value<=0 or p.Value==math.huge or c.Value~=c.Value or c.Value<0 or c.Value==math.huge then
  record.Pending=nil;return
 end
 local combo=Config.Combat.SlapCombo;local deadline=now+(combo.Enabled and combo.SwingWindow or 0)
 local hit,reason=false,'Miss'
 local ok=pcall(function()
  repeat
   if self.Sessions[player]~=record or not self:IsAuthorizedTool(player,tool)then reason='PracticeEnded';break end
   local hum=player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
   if hum.PlatformStand or hum:GetAttribute('MovementLocked')or player.Character:GetAttribute('ArenaRespawnPending')then reason='Unavailable';break end
   local root=player.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
   hit,reason=self:HitDummy(root,p.Value)
   if hit or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()>=deadline then break end
   task.wait(math.min(combo.SampleInterval,math.max(0,deadline-workspace:GetServerTimeNow())))
  until false
 end)
 if not ok then reason='PracticeError';self:RecoverDummy()end
 if self.Sessions[player]~=record then return end
 State.Finish(record,sequence,workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),hit,combo,c.Value)
 if hit then local hand=tool:FindFirstChild('Hand');local sound=hand and hand:FindFirstChild('Hit');if sound and sound:IsA('Sound')then pcall(sound.Play,sound)end end
 self:Feedback(player,record,sequence,hit,reason)
end
function Service:Init(context)
 self.Context=context;self.Slaps=context:GetService('SlapService');self.Ragdoll=context:GetService('RagdollService');self.Rounds=context:GetService('RoundService')
 assert(self.Slaps and self.Ragdoll and self.Rounds,'Training dependencies missing')
 self.Sessions={};self.LastEntry={};self.Connections={};self.DummyDown=false
 local remotes=RS:WaitForChild('Remotes');local folder=remotes:FindFirstChild('Training')
 if not folder then folder=Instance.new('Folder');folder.Name='Training';folder.Parent=remotes end
 local function event(name)local o=folder:FindFirstChild(name);if o then assert(o:IsA('RemoteEvent'));return o end;o=Instance.new('RemoteEvent');o.Name=name;o.Parent=folder;return o end
 self.ActivateRemote=event('Activate');self.LeaveRemote=event('Leave');self.Updated=event('Updated')
end
function Service:BindDummy()
 if self.DummyConnection then self.DummyConnection:Disconnect()end
 local dummy=self.Dummy
 self.DummyConnection=dummy.Destroying:Connect(function()
  if self.Recovery then pcall(task.cancel,self.Recovery);self.Recovery=nil end
  pcall(self.Ragdoll.ResetRagdollImmediate,self.Ragdoll,dummy,true)
 end)
end
function Service:Start()
 self.Zone=workspace:FindFirstChild(Settings.ZoneName)
 if not self.Zone then warn('[Training] TrainingZone missing in Edit; disabled');return end
 self.Bounds=self.Zone:FindFirstChild('Bounds');self.Home=self.Zone:FindFirstChild('DummyHome');self.Entry=self.Zone:FindFirstChild('EntryPad');self.Dummy=self.Zone:FindFirstChild('TrainingDummy')
 assert(self.Bounds and self.Home and self.Entry and self.Dummy,'Incomplete physical training zone')
 self.Template=self.Dummy:Clone();self:BindDummy();self:RecoverDummy()
 table.insert(self.Connections,self.Entry.TrainPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(p)self:Join(p)end))
 table.insert(self.Connections,self.ActivateRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(...)self:Activate(...)end))
 table.insert(self.Connections,self.LeaveRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(p)self:Stop(p)end))
 table.insert(self.Connections,Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)self:Stop(p);self.LastEntry[p]=nil end))
 local elapsed=0
 table.insert(self.Connections,Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  elapsed+=dt;if elapsed<Settings.PollInterval then return end;elapsed=0
  for p in pairs(self.Sessions)do if not self:IsInside(p)then self:Stop(p)end end
  local root=self.Dummy and self.Dummy:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');local h=self.Dummy and self.Dummy:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
  if not self.Dummy or not self.Dummy.Parent or not root or not h or h.Health<=0 then
   if self.Dummy and self.Dummy.Parent then self:RecoverDummy();self.Dummy:Destroy()end
   self.Dummy=self.Template:Clone();self.Dummy.Parent=self.Zone;self:BindDummy();self:RecoverDummy()
  end
 end))
 game:BindToClose(function()for p in pairs(self.Sessions)do self:Stop(p)end;if self.Recovery then pcall(task.cancel,self.Recovery);self.Recovery=nil end;self:RecoverDummy()end)
end
return Service

--!strict
local State={}
function State.Begin(record: any,sequence: any,now: number): (boolean,string?)
 if type(sequence)~='number' or sequence~=sequence or sequence%1~=0 or sequence<1 or sequence>1000000 then return false,'InvalidSequence' end
 if sequence<=(record.LastSequence or 0)then return false,'Replayed' end
 record.LastSequence=sequence
 if record.Pending or now<(record.ReadyAt or 0)then return false,'Recovery' end
 record.Pending=sequence
 return true
end
function State.Finish(record: any,sequence: number,now: number,hit: boolean,combo: any,cooldown: number): boolean
 if record.Pending~=sequence then return false end
 record.Pending=nil
 record.ReadyAt=now+(if combo.Enabled then (if hit then combo.SuccessfulHitRecovery else combo.MissRecovery)else cooldown)
 return true
end
return State

local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')

local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local Controller={Name='AdminController'}
local messages={Forbidden='No tenés permisos de administrador.',RateLimited='Esperá un momento.',DataNotLoaded='El perfil todavía no está disponible. No se aplicó el comando.',PlayerNotConnected='El jugador ya no está conectado.',InvalidTarget='Elegí un UserId válido.',InvalidAmount='Cantidad inválida o fuera del límite.',InvalidSlap='Slap inexistente, limitado o no permitido.',CoinsGranted='Coins acreditados.',SlapGranted='Slap agregado al inventario.',AlreadyOwned='El jugador ya posee ese Slap.',RequestIdConflict='La solicitud no coincide con su operación original.',SessionRequestLimit='Se alcanzó el límite de operaciones de esta sesión.',ExecutionFailedNoAutoRetry='No se pudo confirmar la operación. Revisá el inventario/Output antes de crear otra.'}
function Controller:Message(response)
 self.Hud.MainFrame.Status.Text=messages[response.Reason]or tostring(response.Reason or(response.Ok and 'Operación completada.'or 'Error'))
end
function Controller:ClearForm()
 for _,c in ipairs(self.FormConnections)do c:Disconnect()end;self.FormConnections={}
 for _,o in ipairs(self.Hud.MainFrame.Form:GetChildren())do if o:IsA('Frame')then o:Destroy()end end
 self.Inputs={}
end
function Controller:SelectCommand(command)
 if self.Pending or self.Retry then return end
 self:ClearForm();self.Command=command
 local m=self.Hud.MainFrame;m.Description.Text=command.Description
 for index,field in ipairs(command.Fields)do
  local row=self.Hud.FieldTemplate:Clone();row.Name=field.Name;row.Visible=true;row.LayoutOrder=index;row.Label.Text=field.Label
  row.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,field.Type=='Integer'and 86 or 202)
  row.Input.Text='';row.Input.PlaceholderText=field.Type=='Integer'and(string.format('%d — %d',field.Min,field.Max))or(field.Type=='Player'and 'UserId del jugador o elegir abajo'or 'Id de Slap: Classic:Basic')
  self.Inputs[field.Name]={Input=row.Input,Type=field.Type}
  row.Choices.Visible=field.Type~='Integer'
  local choices=field.Type=='Player'and self.Info.Players or field.Type=='Slap'and self.Info.Slaps or {}
  for order,option in ipairs(choices)do
   local button=self.Hud.ChoiceTemplate:Clone();button.Visible=true;button.LayoutOrder=order
   button.Text=field.Type=='Player'and(option.DisplayName..' (@'..option.Username..') · '..option.UserId)or(option.Label..' · '..option.Id)
   button.Parent=row.Choices
   table.insert(self.FormConnections,button.Activated:Connect(function()if not self.Pending and not self.Retry then row.Input.Text=tostring(option.UserId or option.Id)end end))
  end
  row.Parent=m.Form
 end
end
function Controller:LoadInfo()
 if self.Pending or self.Retry then return end;self.Pending=true
 task.spawn(function()
  local ok,result=pcall(self.Remote.InvokeServer,self.Remote,'Info');self.Pending=false
  if not ok or type(result)~='table'then self.Hud.MainFrame.Status.Text='No se pudo cargar el panel.';return end
  if not result.Ok then self:Message(result);return end
  self.Info=result
  for _,c in ipairs(self.CommandConnections)do c:Disconnect()end;self.CommandConnections={}
  for _,o in ipairs(self.Hud.MainFrame.Commands:GetChildren())do if o:IsA('TextButton')then o:Destroy()end end

-- Identifica de forma autoritativa si una herramienta es un Slap administrado por SlapService
function SlapService:IsSlapTool(tool: any): boolean
	if not tool or typeof(tool) ~= "Instance" or not tool:IsA("Tool") then
		return false
	end

	-- 1. Identificación autoritativa explícita: debe haber sido creada y sellada por GiveSlap
	if tool:GetAttribute("IsSlapWeapon") ~= true then
		return false
	end

	-- 2. Validación estructural complementaria del contenedor de combate
	local config = tool:FindFirstChild("Configuration")
	if not config or not config:FindFirstChild("Power") then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

export type PlayerLockData = {
	slapName: string,
	playerConnections: { RBXScriptConnection },
	charConnections: { RBXScriptConnection },
	isEnforcing: boolean,
	currentTool: Tool?,
}

SlapService._playerLocks = {} :: { [Player]: PlayerLockData }

-- Clona un Slap desde ServerStorage.Slaps, lo entrega al jugador y lo equipa automáticamente
function SlapService:GiveSlap(player: Player, slapName: string?): Tool?
	local crates = self._context and self._context:GetService("CrateService")
	local reward = crates and crates:ResolveEquipped(player)
	local targetName = if reward then crates:GetSlapModel(reward) else (slapName or "Classic")
	local template = self:GetSlapTemplate(targetName)
	if not template then
		-- Fallback a Classic si el solicitado no existe
		template = self:GetSlapTemplate("Classic")
	end
	if not template then
		warn(string.format("[SlapService] No se encontro plantilla de Slap para '%s'", tostring(targetName)))
		return nil
	end

	-- Limpiar cualquier Slap previo para evitar acumulacion
	self:RemoveSlaps(player)

	local clone = template:Clone()
	clone.Name = template.Name
	clone.CanBeDropped = false
	clone:SetAttribute("IsSlapWeapon", true)
	clone:SetAttribute("SlapName", template.Name)
	-- Cosmetic application never touches Configuration, Swing or combat settings.
	if crates and reward and targetName == template.Name then crates:ApplyVariation(clone, reward) end

	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local char = player.Character
	local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if backpack then
		clone.Parent = backpack
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and char and char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			pcall(function()
				humanoid:EquipTool(clone)
			end)
		end
	elseif char then
		clone.Parent = char
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			pcall(function()
				humanoid:EquipTool(clone)
			end)
		end
	else
		clone:Destroy()
		return nil
	end

	-- Si el jugador tiene un lock activo, actualizar la referencia a la nueva herramienta
	local lock = self._playerLocks[player]
	if lock then
		lock.currentTool = clone
	end

	return clone
end

-- Remueve todos los Slap tools del Backpack y Character del jugador
function SlapService:RemoveSlaps(player: Player)
	if not player then return end

	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack then
		for _, child in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
			if self:IsSlapTool(child) then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	local char = player.Character
	if char then
		for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
			if self:IsSlapTool(child) then
				child:Destroy()
			elseif child:IsA("Tool") then
				child.Parent = backpack or player
			end
		end
	end

	-- Restaurar cualquier herramienta ajena preservada en Player hacia Backpack
	if backpack then
		for _, child in ipairs(player:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Tool") then
				if self:IsSlapTool(child) then
					child:Destroy()
				else
					child.Parent = backpack
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Bloquea autoritativamente el equipamiento del jugador para que no pueda desequipar ni cambiar de herramienta
function SlapService:LockAndEquipPlayer(player: Player, slapName: string?)
	if not player or not player:IsA("Player") or not player:IsDescendantOf(Players) then
		return
	end

	self:UnlockPlayer(player)

	local lockData: PlayerLockData = {
		slapName = slapName or "Classic",
		playerConnections = {},
		charConnections = {},
		isEnforcing = false,
		currentTool = nil,
	}
	self._playerLocks[player] = lockData

	local function enforceEquipped()
		if self._playerLocks[player] ~= lockData then return end
		if lockData.isEnforcing then return end

		local char = player.Character
		if not char or not char.Parent or not char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

		local tool = lockData.currentTool

		-- Detectar si hay alguna herramienta no autorizada en Character
		local hasForeignTool = false
		for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
			if item:IsA("Tool") and item ~= tool then
				hasForeignTool = true
				break
			end
		end

		if tool and tool.Parent == char and not hasForeignTool then
			return
		end

		lockData.isEnforcing = true
			local generation = char:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0
			local matchId = player:GetAttribute("MatchId")
			local rounds = self:_getRoundService()
			local session = rounds and rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(player)
			local version = session and session.StateVersion
			local function currentCharacter(): boolean
				return player.Parent == Players and player.Character == char and char.Parent ~= nil
					and (char:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0) == generation
					and not char:GetAttribute("ArenaRespawnPending")
					and player:GetAttribute("MatchId") == matchId
					and player:GetAttribute("ResultsSessionId") == nil
					and (session == nil or (rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(player) == session
						and session.StateVersion == version and rounds:IsSessionActive(session.Id)
						and not session.Closing and not session.Closed and not session.Cancelled and not session.GameplayFrozen))
			end
		task.defer(function()
			-- Verificación estricta de identidad de bloqueo
				if self._playerLocks[player] ~= lockData or not currentCharacter() then
				lockData.isEnforcing = false
				return
			end

			local success, err = pcall(function()
					local c = char
				local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if c and c.Parent and c:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and h and h.Health > 0 then
					local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
					if not backpack then
						backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack", 0.5) :: Backpack?
						-- Validación estricta post-yield si WaitForChild cedió el hilo
							if self._playerLocks[player] ~= lockData or not currentCharacter() or not c:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
							return
						end
					end

					local t = lockData.currentTool

					-- Si backpack está disponible, devolver herramientas ajenas preservadas en Player
					if backpack then
						for _, child in ipairs(player:GetChildren()) do
							if child:IsA("Tool") and child ~= t then
								if not self:IsSlapTool(child) then
									child.Parent = backpack
								else
									child:Destroy()
								end
							end
						end
					end

					-- 1. Desalojar cualquier herramienta ajena del Character hacia el Backpack
					for _, item in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
						if item:IsA("Tool") and item ~= t then
							if backpack then
								item.Parent = backpack
							else
								-- Conservar la herramienta ajena sin destruirla; alojarla en Player temporalmente
								if self:IsSlapTool(item) then
									item:Destroy()
								else
									pcall(function()
										item.Parent = player
									end)
								end
							end
						end
					end

					-- 2. Asegurar que el Slap esté equipado en la mano
					if t and t.Parent == backpack then
						pcall(function()
							h:EquipTool(t)
						end)
					elseif not t or not t:IsDescendantOf(player) or not self:IsSlapTool(t) then
						-- Si el Slap no existe o fue destruido, regenerar y equipar
						local newTool = self:GiveSlap(player, lockData.slapName)
						lockData.currentTool = newTool
						if newTool then
							pcall(function()
								h:EquipTool(newTool)
							end)
						end
					elseif t.Parent ~= c then
						pcall(function()
							h:EquipTool(t)
						end)
					end
				end
			end)

			-- Garantizar que isEnforcing se restablezca siempre
			lockData.isEnforcing = false

			if not success and err then
				warn(string.format("[SlapService] Error durante enforceEquipped para '%s': %s", player.Name, tostring(err)))
			end
		end)
	end

	local function bindCharacter(char: Model)
		for _, c in ipairs(lockData.charConnections) do
			if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
		end
		table.clear(lockData.charConnections)

		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5) :: Humanoid?
		-- Validación estricta post-yield: si la partida terminó o el personaje/jugador ya no es válido, salir sin entregar Slap
		if not hum or self._playerLocks[player] ~= lockData or not char.Parent or not char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not player:IsDescendantOf(Players) then
			return
		end

		-- Entregar y equipar Slap en este character
		local tool = self:GiveSlap(player, lockData.slapName)
		lockData.currentTool = tool
		if tool and hum.Health > 0 and char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			pcall(function()
				hum:EquipTool(tool)
			end)
		end

		-- Escuchar cuando el Slap u otra cosa sale del Character (e.g. unequip)
		local charRemovedConn = char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child: Instance)
			if child:IsA("Tool") and self._playerLocks[player] == lockData then
				enforceEquipped()
			end
		end)
		table.insert(lockData.charConnections, charRemovedConn)

		-- Escuchar cuando otra herramienta es equipada en el Character
		local charAddedConn = char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child: Instance)
			if child:IsA("Tool") and child ~= lockData.currentTool and self._playerLocks[player] == lockData then
				enforceEquipped()
			end
		end)
		table.insert(lockData.charConnections, charAddedConn)

		-- Escuchar cuando una herramienta entra al Backpack (cuando el cliente la desequipa)
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		if backpack then
			local bpConn = backpack.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child: Instance)
				if child:IsA("Tool") and self._playerLocks[player] == lockData then
					enforceEquipped()
				end
			end)
			table.insert(lockData.charConnections, bpConn)
		end
	end

	-- Escuchar si el personaje muere y reaparece (respawn durante partida)
	local charAddedConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar: Model)
		if self._playerLocks[player] == lockData then
			bindCharacter(newChar)
		end
	end)
	table.insert(lockData.playerConnections, charAddedConn)

	-- Si el personaje ya existe actualmente en Workspace
	if player.Character and player.Character.Parent and player.Character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		bindCharacter(player.Character)
	end
end

-- Desbloquea el equipamiento del jugador y limpia todas las conexiones
function SlapService:UnlockPlayer(player: Player)
	local lockData = self._playerLocks[player]
	if lockData then
		for _, c in ipairs(lockData.playerConnections) do
			if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
		end
		for _, c in ipairs(lockData.charConnections) do
			if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
		end
		self._playerLocks[player] = nil
	end
end

function SlapService:IsPlayerLocked(player: Player): boolean
	return self._playerLocks[player] ~= nil
end

-- Only actual players are observed. NPC props, catalog tools and stored inventory are untouched.
function SlapService:_canHoldCombatTool(player: Player, tool: Instance): boolean
 local training=self._context and type(self._context.GetService)=="function" and self._context:GetService("TrainingService")
 if training and type(training.IsAuthorizedTool)=="function" and training:IsAuthorizedTool(player,tool)then return true end
	if not self:IsSlapTool(tool) then return false end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	local rounds = self:_getRoundService()
	local session = rounds and rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(player)
	if not session or session.Closing or session.Closed or session.Cancelled
		or player:GetAttribute("MatchId") ~= session.Id
		or player:GetAttribute("ResultsSessionId") ~= nil
		or not rounds:GetSessionParticipant(session.Id, player) then return false end
	return session.State == Constants.RoundState.StartCountdown or session.State == Constants.RoundState.Playing
		or session.State == Constants.RoundState.PointRestartCountdown
end

function SlapService:_enforceCombatHands(player: Player, character: Model, tool: Instance)
	if not tool:IsA("Tool") then return end
	task.defer(function()
		if player.Parent ~= Players or player.Character ~= character or tool.Parent ~= character
			or self:_canHoldCombatTool(player, tool) then return end
		-- Store, never delete, foreign tools. Managed Slaps still use existing round cleanup.
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		tool.Parent = backpack or player
	end)
end

function SlapService:_bindCombatInventory(player: Player)
	if self._inventoryBindings[player] then return end
	local binding = {}
	self._inventoryBindings[player] = binding
	local function bind(character: Model)
		if binding.Child then binding.Child:Disconnect() end
		binding.Child = character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(tool)
			self:_enforceCombatHands(player, character, tool)
		end)
		for _, tool in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do self:_enforceCombatHands(player, character, tool) end
	end
	binding.Character = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(bind)
	if player.Character then bind(player.Character) end
end

-- Entrega y bloquea los Slaps a todos los contendientes de una partida
function SlapService:EquipMatchPlayers(session: MatchSession, slapName: string?)
	if not session then return end

	local participants: { Player } = {}
	if session.RedTeam and #session.RedTeam > 0 then
		for _, p in ipairs(session.RedTeam) do table.insert(participants, p) end
	elseif session.RedPlayer then
		table.insert(participants, session.RedPlayer)
	end
	if session.BlueTeam and #session.BlueTeam > 0 then
		for _, p in ipairs(session.BlueTeam) do table.insert(participants, p) end
	elseif session.BluePlayer then
		table.insert(participants, session.BluePlayer)
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(participants) do
		self:LockAndEquipPlayer(player, slapName)
	end
end

-- Retira el bloqueo y los Slaps de todos los contendientes de una partida
function SlapService:RemoveMatchPlayers(session: MatchSession)
	if not session then return end

	local participants: { Player } = {}
	if session.RedTeam and #session.RedTeam > 0 then
		for _, p in ipairs(session.RedTeam) do table.insert(participants, p) end
	elseif session.RedPlayer then
		table.insert(participants, session.RedPlayer)
	end
	if session.BlueTeam and #session.BlueTeam > 0 then
		for _, p in ipairs(session.BlueTeam) do table.insert(participants, p) end
	elseif session.BluePlayer then
		table.insert(participants, session.BluePlayer)
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(participants) do
		local attack = self._attacks[player]
		if attack and attack.Session == session then self:_cancelAttack(player, "SessionRemoved") end
		self:UnlockPlayer(player)
		self:RemoveSlaps(player)
	end
end

-- Studio-only, opt-in and bounded. Never log every hitbox sample.
function SlapService:_trace(player: Player, phase: string, record: any?, reason: string?)
	if not RunService:IsStudio() or ReplicatedStorage:GetAttribute("SlapDiagnosticsEnabled") ~= true then return end
	local second = math.floor(os.clock())
	local budget = self._diagnosticBudgets[player]
	if not budget or budget.Second ~= second then
		budget = { Second = second, Count = 0 }; self._diagnosticBudgets[player] = budget
	end
	if budget.Count >= 12 then return end
	budget.Count += 1
	local row = {
		Build = "CombatSystemV132", Side = "Server", Phase = phase, UserId = player.UserId,
		RejectionReason = reason, ServerTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
		Accepted = if phase == "AttackStarted" then true elseif phase == "ServerRejected" then false else nil,
	}
	if record then
		row.SessionId = record.SessionId; row.RoundId = record.RoundId
		row.CharacterGeneration = record.Generation; row.AttackId = record.AttackId
		row.PredictionId = record.PredictionId; row.RequestTime = record.RequestTime
		row.RequestId = record.RequestId; row.AttackStartTime = record.NetworkStart
		row.HitConfirmed = record.HitConfirmed == true; row.AttackWindowClosed = record.WindowClosed
		row.RecoveryType = record.Outcome; row.RecoveryUntil = record.NetworkRecovery
		row.WindowUntil = record.NetworkWindowUntil
		row.PreviousAttackId = record.PreviousAttackId
		row.PreviousRecoveryUntil = record.PreviousRecoveryUntil
		row.StartMonotonic = record.StartTime; row.RecoveryMonotonic = record.RecoveryUntil
		row.PreviousRecoveryMonotonic = record.PreviousRecoveryMonotonic
	end
	print("[SlapTrace] " .. HttpService:JSONEncode(row))
end

function SlapService:_sendAttackFeedback(player: Player, record: any, phase: string, reason: string?)
	if player.Parent ~= Players or not self._slapFeedbackRemote then return end
	self._swingSequence[player] = (self._swingSequence[player] or 0) + 1
	self._slapFeedbackRemote:FireClient(player, {
		Protocol = 3, Sequence = self._swingSequence[player], RequestId = record.RequestId,
		PredictionId = record.PredictionId,
		AttackId = record.AttackId, Phase = phase, Accepted = phase ~= "Rejected",
		Character = record.Character, Generation = record.Generation,
		SessionId = record.SessionId, RoundId = record.RoundId,
		AttackStartTime = record.NetworkStart, AttackWindowClosed = record.WindowClosed,
		WindowUntil = record.NetworkWindowUntil,
		Hit = record.HitConfirmed == true, Outcome = record.Outcome, Reason = reason,
		WindowPending = record.Stage == "Window",
		RecoveryUntil = record.NetworkRecovery, ReadyAt = record.NetworkRecovery,
	})
end

function SlapService:_cancelAttack(player: Player, reason: string)
	local record = self._attacks[player]
	if not record then return end
	-- Detach first. A yielding old attempt can never finalize a replacement.
	self._attacks[player] = nil
	record.Stage = "Cancelled"
	self:_trace(player, "AttackCancelled", record, reason)
end

function SlapService:_sameLife(record: any, player: Player, session: any): boolean
	local char = player.Character
	return record.Character == char and char ~= nil
		and record.Generation == (char:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0)
		and record.Session == session and session ~= nil
		and record.RoundId == (session.GameplayRound and session.GameplayRound.Id)
end

function SlapService:_finishAttack(player: Player, record: any, outcome: string, reason: string?): boolean
	if self._attacks[player] ~= record or record.Stage ~= "Window" then return false end
	record.Stage = "Recovery"; record.Outcome = outcome
	record.HitConfirmed = outcome == "Hit"
	local now = os.clock()
	record.WindowClosed = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	-- Hit recovery starts at accepted RegisterHit; Miss starts at window close.
	local combo = Config.Combat.SlapCombo
	local duration = if combo.Enabled then
		(if outcome == "Hit" then combo.SuccessfulHitRecovery else combo.MissRecovery) else record.ToolCooldown
	record.RecoveryUntil = now + duration
	record.NetworkRecovery = record.WindowClosed + duration
	self:_trace(player, "RecoverySet", record, reason)
	return true
end

function SlapService:_handleRequest(player: Player, tool: any, request: any)
	-- RequestId is correlation only. The server owns attack identity and clocks.
	if type(request) ~= "table" or type(request.RequestId) ~= "number"
		or request.RequestId ~= request.RequestId or request.RequestId < 1
		or request.RequestId % 1 ~= 0 or request.RequestId > 9007199254740991 then return end
	if type(request.PredictionId) ~= "string" or #request.PredictionId > 160
		or #request.PredictionId < 1 or request.PredictionId:find("[^%w:_%-]") then return end
	local rounds = self:_getRoundService()
	local session = rounds and rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(player)
	local char = player.Character
	local attempt = { RequestId = request.RequestId, PredictionId = request.PredictionId,
		RequestTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), Character = char,
		Generation = char and (char:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0),
		SessionId = session and session.Id, RoundId = session and session.GameplayRound and session.GameplayRound.Id }
	self:_trace(player, "RequestReceived", attempt)
	local function reject(reason: string)
		local current = self._attacks[player]
		if current and self:_sameLife(current, player, session) then
			attempt.AttackId = current.AttackId; attempt.Stage = current.Stage
			attempt.NetworkRecovery = current.NetworkRecovery
		end
		self:_trace(player, "ServerRejected", attempt, reason)
		self:_sendAttackFeedback(player, attempt, "Rejected", reason)
	end
	local previous = self._requestIds[player] or 0
	if request.RequestId <= previous then reject("RequestReplayed"); return end
	self._requestIds[player] = request.RequestId
	if request.Character ~= char or request.Generation ~= attempt.Generation
		or request.SessionId ~= attempt.SessionId or request.RoundId ~= attempt.RoundId then
		reject("RequestScopeMismatch"); return
	end
	-- The holder is local to THIS call, never read an error's owner from _attacks.
	local ok, hit, reason = pcall(self.ProcessSlap, self, player, tool, attempt)
	local record = attempt.Attack
	if not ok then
		local now = os.clock()
		if now >= (self._errorUntil[player] or 0) then
			self._errorUntil[player] = now + 5
			warn("[SlapService] AttackError UserId=" .. tostring(player.UserId)
				.. " AttackId=" .. tostring(record and record.AttackId)
				.. " " .. string.sub(tostring(hit), 1, 200))
		end
		reason = "InternalError"
		if record then self:_finishAttack(player, record, "Miss", reason) end
	end
	if record then
		if self._attacks[player] == record then
			self:_sendAttackFeedback(player, record, "Result", reason)
		else
			-- Obsolete result carries its ORIGINAL life/round and cannot affect a new request.
			self:_sendAttackFeedback(player, record, "Cancelled", reason or "AttackObsolete")
		end
	else
		reject(reason or "Rejected")
	end
end

-- Valida que la herramienta sea un Slap autorizado con Configuration valida
function SlapService:_validateTool(player: Player, tool: any): (boolean, number, number, string?)
	if not tool or typeof(tool) ~= "Instance" or not tool:IsA("Tool") then
		return false, 0, 0, "InvalidToolInstance"
	end

	-- Debe ser un Slap legítimo administrado por SlapService
	if not self:IsSlapTool(tool) then
		return false, 0, 0, "NotAuthorizedSlap"
	end

	-- Debe estar equipada en el Character activo del jugador
	local char = player.Character
	if not char or tool.Parent ~= char then
		return false, 0, 0, "ToolNotEquipped"
	end

	local config = tool:FindFirstChild("Configuration")
	if not config then
		return false, 0, 0, "MissingConfiguration"
	end

	local powerVal = config:FindFirstChild("Power")
	if not powerVal or not powerVal:IsA("NumberValue") or powerVal.Value <= 0 or powerVal.Value~=powerVal.Value or powerVal.Value==math.huge then
		return false, 0, 0, "InvalidPowerValue"
	end

	local cooldownVal = config:FindFirstChild("SlapCooldown")
	if not cooldownVal or not cooldownVal:IsA("NumberValue") or cooldownVal.Value < 0 or cooldownVal.Value~=cooldownVal.Value or cooldownVal.Value==math.huge then
		return false, 0, 0, "InvalidCooldownValue"
	end

	return true, powerVal.Value, cooldownVal.Value, nil
end

local function isPlayer(p: any): boolean
	if not p then return false end
	if typeof(p) == "Instance" then
		return p:IsA("Player")
	end
	if (typeof(p) == "userdata" or typeof(p) == "table") and type(p.IsA) == "function" then
		return p:IsA("Player")
	end
	return false
end

-- Selecciona como máximo un oponente usando exclusivamente el registro
-- autoritativo de la sesión. Prioridad: menor distancia, luego Slot y UserId.
-- Shared geometry/launch math. Training never enters the PvP participant pipeline.
function SlapService:CheckTargetGeometry(attackerRoot: BasePart, victimRoot: BasePart): (boolean, Vector3, string?)
 local diff=victimRoot.Position-attackerRoot.Position
 local distance=diff.Magnitude
 if distance>MAX_SLAP_REACH then return false,diff,"OutOfReach" end
 local forward=attackerRoot.CFrame.LookVector
 local direction=if distance>0.05 then diff.Unit else forward
 if forward:Dot(direction)<MIN_FACING_DOT then return false,diff,"TargetBehindAttacker" end
 return true,diff,nil
end
function SlapService:ComputeSlapLaunchVelocity(attackerRoot: BasePart, victimRoot: BasePart, power: number): Vector3
 local diff=victimRoot.Position-attackerRoot.Position
 local horizontal=Vector3.new(diff.X,0,diff.Z)
 local direction=if horizontal.Magnitude>0.1 then horizontal.Unit else attackerRoot.CFrame.LookVector
 local upwardRatio=0.35
 return direction*(power*(1-upwardRatio*0.2))+Vector3.new(0,math.max(power*upwardRatio*1.3,26),0)
end

function SlapService:_selectOpponent(
	attacker: Player,
	session: MatchSession,
	attackerRoot: BasePart
): (Player?, BasePart?, Vector3?, string?)
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	if not roundService
		or type(roundService.GetSessionParticipant) ~= "function"
		or type(roundService.GetSessionForPlayer) ~= "function"
		or type(roundService.GetSessionById) ~= "function"
		or type(roundService.IsSessionActive) ~= "function"
		or roundService:GetSessionById(session.Id) ~= session
		or not roundService:IsSessionActive(session.Id)
		or session.State ~= Constants.RoundState.Playing
		or session.Closing or session.Cancelled or session.Closed then
		return nil, nil, nil, "SessionNotCombatReady"
	end

	local attackerParticipant = roundService:GetSessionParticipant(session.Id, attacker)
	if not attackerParticipant then return nil, nil, nil, "AttackerNotParticipant" end

	local selected: Player? = nil
	local selectedRoot: BasePart? = nil
	local selectedDiff: Vector3? = nil
	local selectedDistance = math.huge
	local selectedSlot = math.huge
	local selectedUserId = math.huge
	local firstRejection: string? = nil
	local forwardDir = attackerRoot.CFrame.LookVector
	local combatService = self:_getCombatService()
	if not combatService then return nil, nil, nil, "CombatServiceUnavailable" end

	for _, rosterParticipant in ipairs(session.Participants) do
		if rosterParticipant.Team == attackerParticipant.Team
			or rosterParticipant.State == "Left"
			or rosterParticipant.State == "Released" then
			continue
		end

		local candidate = rosterParticipant.Player
		if not isPlayer(candidate) or candidate == attacker or candidate.Parent ~= Players then
			firstRejection = firstRejection or "InvalidOpponent"
			continue
		end
		if roundService:GetSessionForPlayer(candidate) ~= session
			or roundService:GetSessionParticipant(session.Id, candidate) ~= rosterParticipant then
			firstRejection = firstRejection or "DifferentMatch"
			continue
		end

		local character = candidate.Character
			if character and character:GetAttribute("ArenaRespawnPending") then
				firstRejection = firstRejection or "VictimRespawning"
				continue
			end
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not root then
			firstRejection = firstRejection or "VictimNotSpawned"
			continue
		end
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			firstRejection = firstRejection or "VictimNotAlive"
			continue
		end
		if combatService:IsHitProtected(candidate, session) then
			firstRejection = firstRejection or "VictimHitProtected"
			continue
		end

  local reachable,diff,geometryReason=self:CheckTargetGeometry(attackerRoot,root)
  local distance=diff.Magnitude
  if not reachable then firstRejection=firstRejection or geometryReason;continue end

		local slot = rosterParticipant.Slot
		local userId = rosterParticipant.UserId
		if distance < selectedDistance
			or (distance == selectedDistance and slot < selectedSlot)
			or (distance == selectedDistance and slot == selectedSlot and userId < selectedUserId) then
			selected = candidate
			selectedRoot = root
			selectedDiff = diff
			selectedDistance = distance
			selectedSlot = slot
			selectedUserId = userId
		end
	end

	return selected, selectedRoot, selectedDiff, if selected then nil else (firstRejection or "NoValidOpponent")
end

-- Ejecuta la resolucion autoritativa del golpe
function SlapService:ProcessSlap(attacker: Player, tool: Tool, attempt: any?): (boolean, string?)
	-- 1. Validar que el atacante sea un Player valido
	if not isPlayer(attacker) or not attacker.Parent then
		return false, "InvalidAttacker"
	end

	local attackerChar = attacker.Character
	if attackerChar and attackerChar:GetAttribute("ArenaRespawnPending") then return false, "AttackerRespawning" end
	if not attackerChar or not attackerChar:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		return false, "AttackerCharNotSpawned"
	end

	local attackerHumanoid = attackerChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local attackerRoot = attackerChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not attackerHumanoid or attackerHumanoid.Health <= 0 or not attackerRoot then
		return false, "AttackerNotAlive"
	end

	if attackerHumanoid.PlatformStand then return false,"AttackerKnockedDown" end
	if attackerHumanoid:GetAttribute("MovementLocked") == true then return false, "MovementLocked" end

	-- 2. Validar que la herramienta sea un Slap valido y este equipada
	local okTool, power, cooldown, toolErr = self:_validateTool(attacker, tool)
	if not okTool then
		return false, toolErr or "ToolValidationFailed"
	end

	-- 3. Validar estado de la partida (solo en estado PLAYING)
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	if not roundService then
		return false, "RoundServiceUnavailable"
	end

	local session = roundService:GetSessionForPlayer(attacker)
	if not session then
		return false, "NotInMatch"
	end

	if session.State ~= Constants.RoundState.Playing or not roundService:IsGameplayRoundOpen(session) then
		return false, "MatchNotPlaying"
	end

	-- 4. Validar cooldown del servidor
	local now = os.clock()
	local previous = self._attacks[attacker]
	if previous and not self:_sameLife(previous, attacker, session) then
		self:_cancelAttack(attacker, "LifeOrRoundChanged"); previous = nil
	end
	if previous and (previous.Stage == "Window" or now < previous.RecoveryUntil) then
		return false, "OnCooldown"
	end

	local combo=Config.Combat.SlapCombo
 local roundId=session.GameplayRound.Id
 local generation=attackerChar:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0
 local swingDeadline=now+(if combo.Enabled then combo.SwingWindow else 0)
	self._attackSerial += 1
	local record = { AttackId = session.Id .. ":Slap:" .. tostring(self._attackSerial),
		RequestId = attempt and attempt.RequestId, PredictionId = attempt and attempt.PredictionId,
		RequestTime = attempt and attempt.RequestTime, Character = attackerChar, Generation = generation,
		Session = session, SessionId = session.Id, RoundId = roundId, Stage = "Window",
		StartTime = now, NetworkStart = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), ToolCooldown = cooldown }
	record.NetworkWindowUntil = record.NetworkStart + (if combo.Enabled then combo.SwingWindow else 0)
	record.PreviousAttackId = previous and previous.AttackId
	record.PreviousRecoveryUntil = previous and previous.NetworkRecovery
	record.PreviousRecoveryMonotonic = previous and previous.RecoveryUntil
	self._attacks[attacker] = record
	if attempt then attempt.Attack = record end
	self:_trace(attacker, "AttackStarted", record)
	self:_sendAttackFeedback(attacker, record, "Started")
 local opponent: Player?=nil
 local victimRoot: BasePart?=nil
 local diff: Vector3?=nil
 local targetReason: string?=nil
 repeat
  if self._attacks[attacker] ~= record or attacker.Character~=attackerChar or attacker.Parent~=Players or tool.Parent~=attackerChar
   or (attackerChar:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0)~=generation
   or attackerHumanoid.Health <= 0 or attackerHumanoid.PlatformStand
   or attackerHumanoid:GetAttribute("MovementLocked") == true or attackerChar:GetAttribute("ArenaRespawnPending")
   or roundService:GetSessionForPlayer(attacker) ~= session
   or not roundService:IsGameplayRoundOpen(session) or session.GameplayRound.Id~=roundId then
   self:_finishAttack(attacker,record,"Miss","SwingInvalidated");return false,"SwingInvalidated"
  end
  opponent,victimRoot,diff,targetReason=self:_selectOpponent(attacker,session,attackerRoot)
  if opponent then break end
  if os.clock()>=swingDeadline then break end
  task.wait(math.min(combo.SampleInterval,math.max(0,swingDeadline-os.clock())))
 until false
 if not opponent or not victimRoot or not diff then
  self:_finishAttack(attacker,record,"Miss",targetReason or "NoValidOpponent")
  return false,targetReason or "NoValidOpponent"
 end
	local victimChar = opponent.Character :: Model
	local forwardDir = attackerRoot.CFrame.LookVector

	-- 7. Registrar impacto autoritativo en CombatService
	local combatService = self:_getCombatService()
	if not combatService then
		self:_finishAttack(attacker,record,"Miss","CombatServiceUnavailable")
		return false, "CombatServiceUnavailable"
	end

	local abilities = self._context and self._context:GetService("AbilityService")
	local hitTicket = abilities and abilities:PrepareHit(attacker, session)
	-- Hooks may yield: recheck the owner before committing any combat side effect.
	if self._attacks[attacker] ~= record or not self:_sameLife(record, attacker, session)
		or attackerHumanoid.Health <= 0 or attackerHumanoid.PlatformStand
		or attackerHumanoid:GetAttribute("MovementLocked") == true
		or attackerChar:GetAttribute("ArenaRespawnPending") or tool.Parent ~= attackerChar
		or not roundService:IsGameplayRoundOpen(session) then
		self:_finishAttack(attacker, record, "Miss", "SwingInvalidated")
		return false, "SwingInvalidated"
	end
	local hitSuccess, hitReason, receivedHits = combatService:RegisterHit(attacker, opponent, session.Id, hitTicket ~= nil and hitTicket.SkipComboCount == true)
	if not hitSuccess then
		self:_finishAttack(attacker,record,"Miss",hitReason or "CombatServiceRejected")
		return false, hitReason or "CombatServiceRejected"
	end

	self:_finishAttack(attacker,record,"Hit")

	-- 8. Reproducir feedback sonoro de impacto
	local hand = tool:FindFirstChild("Hand")
	local hitSound = hand and hand:FindFirstChild("Hit") :: Sound?
	if hitSound and hitSound:IsA("Sound") then
		pcall(function()
			hitSound:Play()
		end)
	end

	if hitTicket then
	 local consumed,cue,reason=abilities:ConsumeHit(attacker, session, opponent, hitTicket)
	 if consumed then
	  local elimination=self._context and self._context:GetService("EliminationService")
	  if elimination and elimination:HandleAbilityHit(opponent,session,attacker,reason) then
	   abilities:PresentCue(session,cue)
	  end
	  return true,nil
	 end
	end
	if (receivedHits or 0)>=Config.Combat.SlapElimination.HitsToEliminate then
  local elimination=self._context and self._context:GetService("EliminationService")
  if elimination then elimination:HandleSlapThreshold(opponent,session,attacker) end
  return true,nil
 end

	-- 9. Aplicar knockback y ragdoll autoritativo via RagdollService
	local ragdollService = self:_getRagdollService()
	if ragdollService then
		local launchVelocity = self:ComputeSlapLaunchVelocity(attackerRoot,victimRoot,power)
		ragdollService:ApplyRagdoll(victimChar, Config.Combat.DefaultSlapKnockdownDuration, launchVelocity)
	end

	print(string.format("[SlapService] Slap exitoso: '%s' golpeo a '%s' con '%s' (Power=%d, Cooldown=%.2f)",
		attacker.Name, opponent.Name, tool.Name, power, cooldown))

	return true, nil
end

function SlapService:Init(context: any)
	self._context = context
	self._attacks = {}
	self._requestIds = {}
	self._attackSerial = 0
	self._diagnosticBudgets = {}
	self._errorUntil = {}
	self._inventoryBindings = {}
	self._swingSequence = {}
	self:_ensureRemotes()
end

function SlapService:Start(context: any)
	self._context = context
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do self:_bindCombatInventory(player) end
	table.insert(self._connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) self:_bindCombatInventory(player) end))

	-- Escuchar activacion remota desde el cliente
	if self._performSlapRemote then
		local conn = self._performSlapRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, tool: any, request: any)
			self:_handleRequest(player, tool, request)
		end)
		table.insert(self._connections, conn)
	end

	-- Limpieza de cooldowns y bloqueos cuando un jugador se desconecta
	local leaveConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		self:_cancelAttack(player, "PlayerRemoving")
		self._requestIds[player] = nil
		self._diagnosticBudgets[player] = nil
		self._errorUntil[player] = nil
		local binding = self._inventoryBindings[player]
		if binding then
			if binding.Child then binding.Child:Disconnect() end
			if binding.Character then binding.Character:Disconnect() end
			self._inventoryBindings[player] = nil
		end
		self._swingSequence[player] = nil
		self:UnlockPlayer(player)
	end)
	table.insert(self._connections, leaveConn)

	print("[SlapService] Servicio centralizado de Slaps iniciado y listo (CombatSystemV132 Protocol=3)")
end

return SlapService

--!strict
-- Bootstrap
-- Punto de entrada del servidor. Requiere los servicios, ejecuta Init() y Start()
-- en orden controlado, y maneja errores de inicializacion de forma clara.

local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local ServicesFolder = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Services", 10)
assert(ServicesFolder, "[Bootstrap] No se encontro ServerScriptService.Services")

local PersistenceFolder = ServicesFolder:WaitForChild("Persistence", 10)
assert(PersistenceFolder, "[Bootstrap] No se encontro ServerScriptService.Services.Persistence")
local PersistenceEnvironment = require(PersistenceFolder:WaitForChild("PersistenceEnvironment"))
local persistenceSelection = PersistenceEnvironment.Resolve()

print(string.format(
	"[Bootstrap] PersistenceEnvironment=%s PersistenceProvider=%s WritesToCloud=%s GameId=%d PlaceId=%d",
	persistenceSelection.Environment,
	persistenceSelection.ProviderName,
	tostring(persistenceSelection.WritesToCloud),
	persistenceSelection.GameId,
	persistenceSelection.PlaceId
))
if persistenceSelection.BlockedReason then
	warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Persistencia bloqueada de forma segura: %s", persistenceSelection.BlockedReason))
end

-- Seal the approved ability catalog before ShopService builds its products.
-- Only direct, explicitly named ModuleScripts are eligible for require.
local abilityFolder = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Abilities")
local AbilityRegistry = require(ServicesFolder:WaitForChild("AbilityRegistry"))
local AbilityAssets = require(abilityFolder:WaitForChild("AbilityAssetValidator"))
AbilityRegistry.Initialize({
 Manifest = require(abilityFolder:WaitForChild("AbilityManifest")),
 DefaultId = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.AbilityDefinitions).DefaultId,
 Resolve = function(name)
  local found
  for _,child in ipairs(abilityFolder:GetChildren()) do
   if child.Name == name then
    assert(found == nil, "AmbiguousAbilityModule: " .. name)
    found = child
   end
  end
  return found
 end,
 IsModule = function(value) return value:IsA("ModuleScript") and value.Parent == abilityFolder end,
 Load = require,
 HasDependency = function(name)
  local dependency = abilityFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
  return name == "MovementGuard" and dependency ~= nil and dependency:IsA("ModuleScript")
 end,
 CheckAssets = function(assets)
  return AbilityAssets.Validate(assets, game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AbilityEffects"))
 end,
 Warn = warn,
})

-- Orden de carga controlado. Cada servicio expone Name, Init(context) y Start(context).
local SERVICE_ORDER = {
	"PlayerDataService",
	"PlayerService",
	"ShopService",
	"RagdollService",
	"MatchInstanceService",
	"SpawnService",
	"PointFeedbackService",
	"PointEffectTestService",
	"ScoreService",
	"RoundService",
	"MatchmakingFeedbackService",
	"MatchmakingService",
	"CombatService",
	"KnockbackService",
	"EliminationService",
	"DeathEffectService",
	"SlapService",
	"AbilityService",
	"CrateService",
	"CoinShopAccessService",
	"PremiumShopService",
	"SocialPlayService",
	"SocialService",
	"TrainingService",
	"AdminService",
}

local loadedServices: { [string]: any } = {}
local initializedServices = {}

-- Carga de modulos
for _, name in ipairs(SERVICE_ORDER) do
	local moduleScript = ServicesFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not moduleScript or not moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Servicio no encontrado o invalido: %s", name))
		continue
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(require, moduleScript)
	if not ok then
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Error al requerir %s: %s", name, tostring(result)))
		continue
	end

	loadedServices[name] = result
end

-- Contexto compartido: permite referencias controladas sin dependencias circulares.
local context = {
	Services = loadedServices,
	PersistenceProvider = persistenceSelection.Provider,
	PersistenceInfo = persistenceSelection,
	GetService = function(_self, name: string)
		return loadedServices[name]
	end,
}

-- Init() en todos
for _, name in ipairs(SERVICE_ORDER) do
	local service = loadedServices[name]
	if not service then
		continue
	end

	if type(service.Init) == "function" then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			service:Init(context)
		end)
		if ok then
			table.insert(initializedServices, name)
		else
			warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Error en Init() de %s: %s", name, tostring(err)))
		end
	else
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] %s no implementa Init()", name))
	end
end

-- Start() en todos
for _, name in ipairs(SERVICE_ORDER) do
	local service = loadedServices[name]
	if not service then
		continue
	end

	if type(service.Start) == "function" then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			service:Start(context)
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Error en Start() de %s: %s", name, tostring(err)))
		end
	else
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] %s no implementa Start()", name))
	end
end

print(string.format("[Bootstrap] Servicios inicializados: %s", table.concat(initializedServices, ", ")))
print("[Bootstrap] Arranque completado")
